title: Why-dropped split hidden for a class whose only drops are severed-cull drops (no Drop_Site row)
evidence:
app/main.odin:1476: `if acc.dropped > 0 && int(c) < len(app.drop_reasons) {`
app/main.odin:1474: `// sums to the drop count — every loss keeps a named cause.`
core/flow.odin:855-856 (2.3 silent severance cull, inside flow_step step 5): `if !alive {` / `sla_count_drop(&state.flow, p.class)` — counts an SLA drop with NO event and NO Drop_Site
core/flow.odin:205-207: `sla_count_drop :: proc(f: ^Flow_State, class: u16) {` / `sla_ensure(f, class)` / `f.sla[class].dropped += 1` — the class's f.sla row exists, so the gauge iterates it
detail: drop_reasons rows are grown only from Drop_Site sites (feed_drop_sites). A class whose drops all came from the silent severance cull (sla_count_drop, no site) never gets a row, so this guard hides the split entirely: 'drop N' shows with no cause and the promised 'severed' residual is never named. Reachable: demolish a node stranding packets of a class that never ladder-dropped.
recommended_fix: When acc.dropped > 0 but int(c) >= len(app.drop_reasons), synthesize the split with pool=0, queue=0, severed=dropped (or lazily append the row) so the residual is always named.

title: Rejection toast overlays the new queue-depth row at the panel bottom
evidence:
app/qos_panel.odin:475-476: `if app.last_reject != .None && app.tick - app.reject_tick < 30 {` / `draw_text(app, reject_label(app.last_reject), QOS_PANEL_X + 10, i32(panel.y + panel.height) - 18, 14, rl.Color{184, 52, 52, 255})`
app/qos_panel.odin:444-446: `qd_y := qos_queue_depth_y(app)` / `depth_label := fmt.tprintf("queue depth (bound %d):", bound)` / `draw_text(app, depth_label, QOS_PANEL_X + 10, qd_y + 3, 14, p.ink_soft)` — qd_y is the panel's last row (qos_row_y(4+len+1) = panel bottom - 22), so the depth text top is bottom - 19, 1px above the toast top at bottom - 18
detail: A rejected QoS edit (e.g. E6 all-lanes-zeroed cycle -> .Invalid_Weights) draws the toast at panel bottom - 18 for 30 ticks, exactly over the new last-row readout — the depth numbers are covered while the player is actively editing.
recommended_fix: Anchor the toast above the queue-depth row (e.g. qos_queue_depth_y(app) - 18) or reserve the row; the toast stays inside the panel.
